market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil at $108 and diesel at $6 create inflationary pressure; Fed likely to hike or hold higher. AI sector faces volatility from Burry's short thesis and OpenAI governance concerns. Energy and defense names outperform. Expect 5-8% equity volatility in next 30 days.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI infrastructure (data centers, sovereign AI, security) remains structurally strong. India/Korea emerge as capital magnets. Energy transition (Europe solar storage) creates 5-year investment theme. Multipolar trade realignment benefits diversified portfolios. 12-month equity target: modest 8-12% gains with sector rotation from AI software to infrastructure.
